warning: PROTOTYPE TRAINED ON SYNTHETIC DATA. Verified to carry no measurable signal (test ROC-AUC indistinguishable from a shuffled-label control). These metrics describe a synthetic dataset, NOT real-world Chennai flood accuracy. This model is retained as a documented negative result and must not be used for operational flood prediction.

dataset.provenance: Flood risk dataset for India, supplied as a single CSV of 10,000 synthetic samples. It is NOT an observational record of real flood events.

limitations: Dataset is synthetic; the label is statistically independent of all features.
Dataset is India-wide with only a handful of rows near Chennai.
Elevation values in the dataset are implausible for city-scale analysis.
The model cannot consume live Chennai zone inputs without imputing several columns.
It is not an official flood-warning system and must not inform emergency decisions.
